harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 (RHEL 10) and configured its login sessions with an 8192 open-file limit and a 256-process limit via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf. Verified enforcement through a real login-style session (sudo -u appworker sh -lc 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until exec was available again, confirmed a changed boot_id, and re-verified the account and limits survived the restart.
actions_performed: Checked node1 OS and confirmed appworker did not yet exist
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile 8192 and soft/hard nproc 256
Verified limits via sudo -u appworker login-style shell (ulimit -n / ulimit -u)
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime -s before restart
Issued shutdown -r now in background so ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was reachable again
Confirmed boot_id changed (7ef78016... -> c45f9423...) and uptime -s changed, proving an actual restart
Re-verified appworker account, limits.d config, and enforced ulimits post-restart

evidence.summary: Confirmed no prior appworker user existed, then created it with useradd -m; id/getent show uid=1000(appworker).

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d config with nofile/nproc 8192/256, then proved enforcement in an actual appworker login-style shell: ulimit -n=8192, ulimit -u=256.
Captured boot_id 7ef78016-ba83-4481-867b-e5a349df1b54 and uptime -s 2026-09-03 08:24:54, plus confirmed appworker account present, before restart.
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now'; command stream closed as node went down, consistent with ack returning before the disconnect.

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed after restart (proof of actual reboot)
evidence.summary: Polled node1 (two timeouts while down) until exec succeeded again with new boot_id c45f9423-2588-4918-8869-d277ba0fd3b4 and new uptime -s 2026-09-03 08:25:46, differing from the pre-restart baseline.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of appworker account and limits
evidence.summary: After restart, getent passwd shows appworker intact, limits.d/appworker.conf content unchanged, and a live appworker shell still reports ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256.
